description: Use when creating signals, effects, memos, resources, or managing component lifecycle in SolidJS. Prevents React useState/useEffect anti-patterns that break fine-grained reactivity tracking. Covers createSignal, createEffect, createMemo, createResource, createRenderEffect, createComputed, batch, untrack, on, onMount, onCleanup, observable, and from. Keywords: createSignal, createEffect, createMemo, createResource, batch, untrack, onMount, onCleanup, SolidJS reactivity, signals.
